description: Single-IP investigation with readable services (port→app) and peer GeoIP. NetFlow has no DNS/SNI domains.

options.content:
**How to read this page:** NetFlow/sFlow does **not** carry domain names or URLs. We label traffic by **well-known port → app** (HTTPS/DNS/SSH…) and **peer GeoIP** (country/city) so “what was accessed” is readable.

1. Enter **IP**  2. Prefer **As = Source** to see outbound destinations  3. Use time range on the top right.

targets.query:
SELECT sum(bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) AS traffic
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND '$ip' != ''
  AND (
        ('$role' = 'any' AND (
            if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip'
         OR if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) = '$ip'
        ))
     OR ('$role' = 'src' AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip')
     OR ('$role' = 'dst' AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) = '$ip')
  )

SELECT count() AS flows
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND '$ip' != ''
  AND (
        ('$role' = 'any' AND (
            if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip'
         OR if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) = '$ip'
        ))
     OR ('$role' = 'src' AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip')
     OR ('$role' = 'dst' AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) = '$ip')
  )

SELECT uniqExact(dst_port) AS services
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND '$ip' != ''
  AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip'

SELECT uniqExact(peer) AS peers
FROM
(
    SELECT if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) AS peer
    FROM $table
    WHERE $timeFilter
      AND '$ip' != ''
      AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip'
)
WHERE peer != ''

panels.description: Outbound traffic by application category (Web / DNS / Remote / …) based on destination port.

targets.query:
SELECT
    if(
        nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'category', toUInt64(dst_port)), '') = '',
        'Other',
        dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'category', toUInt64(dst_port))
    ) AS category,
    sum(bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) AS traffic
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND '$ip' != ''
  AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip'
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY traffic DESC

panels.title: Outbound by category (what kind)

panels.description: Apps inferred from destination port (HTTPS/DNS/SSH…). Unknown ports show as port-N.

targets.query:
SELECT
    if(
        nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)), '') = '',
        concat('port-', toString(dst_port)),
        dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port))
    ) AS service,
    if(
        nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'category', toUInt64(dst_port)), '') = '',
        'Other',
        dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'category', toUInt64(dst_port))
    ) AS category,
    dst_port,
    ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), toString(proto)) AS protocol,
    sum(bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) AS traffic,
    count() AS flows,
    uniqExact(if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr))) AS peers
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND '$ip' != ''
  AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip'
GROUP BY service, category, dst_port, protocol
ORDER BY traffic DESC
LIMIT toUInt64OrZero('$topn')

panels.title: Outbound services (what apps)

panels.description: Readable destinations this IP talked to (as source): App → peer IP (country/city). Requires GeoIP dict for place names.

targets.query:
SELECT
    accessed,
    service,
    peer,
    place,
    sum(traffic) AS traffic,
    sum(flows) AS flows
FROM
(
    SELECT
        if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) AS peer,
        if(
            nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)), '') = '',
            concat('port-', toString(dst_port)),
            dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port))
        ) AS service,
        if(
            etype = 2048,
            multiIf(
                dictGetString('geoip_trie', 'country_code', reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))) = '',
                '',
                dictGetString('geoip_trie', 'city', reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))) = '',
                dictGetString('geoip_trie', 'country_code', reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))),
                concat(
                    dictGetString('geoip_trie', 'country_code', reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))),
                    ' / ',
                    dictGetString('geoip_trie', 'city', reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4)))
                )
            ),
            ''
        ) AS place,
        concat(
            if(
                nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)), '') = '',
                concat('port-', toString(dst_port)),
                dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port))
            ),
            ' → ',
            if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)),
            if(
                etype = 2048 AND dictGetString('geoip_trie', 'country_code', reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))) != '',
                concat(
                    ' (',
                    multiIf(
                        dictGetString('geoip_trie', 'city', reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))) = '',
                        dictGetString('geoip_trie', 'country_code', reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))),
                        concat(
                            dictGetString('geoip_trie', 'country_code', reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))),
                            '/',
                            dictGetString('geoip_trie', 'city', reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4)))
                        )
                    ),
                    ')'
                ),
                ''
            )
        ) AS accessed,
        bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate) AS traffic,
        1 AS flows
    FROM $table
    WHERE $timeFilter
      AND '$ip' != ''
      AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip'
)
GROUP BY accessed, service, peer, place
ORDER BY traffic DESC
LIMIT toUInt64OrZero('$topn')

panels.title: What this IP accessed (outbound: app → peer)

panels.description: Who talked TO this IP (inbound), with service on the destination port of the flow.

targets.query:
SELECT
    concat(
        if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)),
        ' → ',
        if(
            nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)), '') = '',
            concat('port-', toString(dst_port)),
            dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port))
        ),
        ' on ',
        '$ip'
    ) AS inbound,
    if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) AS source,
    if(
        nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)), '') = '',
        concat('port-', toString(dst_port)),
        dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port))
    ) AS service,
    dst_port,
    sum(bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) AS traffic,
    count() AS flows
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND '$ip' != ''
  AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) = '$ip'
GROUP BY inbound, source, service, dst_port
ORDER BY traffic DESC
LIMIT toUInt64OrZero('$topn')

panels.title: Who accessed this IP (inbound)

targets.query:
SELECT
    $timeSeries AS t,
    if(
        nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)), '') = '',
        concat('port-', toString(dst_port)),
        dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port))
    ) AS service,
    sum(bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) AS traffic
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND '$ip' != ''
  AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip'
GROUP BY t, service
ORDER BY t
LIMIT 5000

panels.title: Outbound traffic by service over time

targets.query:
SELECT
    if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) AS source,
    if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) AS destination,
    if(
        nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port)), '') = '',
        concat('port-', toString(dst_port)),
        dictGetString('dictionaries.services', 'name', toUInt64(dst_port))
    ) AS service,
    ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), toString(proto)) AS protocol,
    src_port,
    dst_port,
    sum(bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) AS traffic,
    count() AS flows
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND '$ip' != ''
  AND (
        ('$role' = 'any' AND (
            if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip'
         OR if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) = '$ip'
        ))
     OR ('$role' = 'src' AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) = '$ip')
     OR ('$role' = 'dst' AND if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) = '$ip')
  )
GROUP BY source, destination, service, protocol, src_port, dst_port
ORDER BY traffic DESC
LIMIT toUInt64OrZero('$detail_rows')
